errors.description:
Every rejected op, with `op_index` set. Rejected ops are skipped; the rest still apply,
so the LLM gets all its mistakes back in one repair round.

inverse.description: Undo for the ops that did apply.

description: Outcome of a trial batch (the orchestrator's composer draft).
title: Trial

hints.description: Kept sorted and de-duplicated so the order never depends on edit history.

library.description:
Component definitions the parts use (`lib:<name>`), embedded so the circuit is
self-contained (LLD §17 D1). Changed only by `lib.*` ops.

params.description: Every param declared by the registry part, keyed by name ("resistance" -> 10kΩ).

Quantity.description: A parsed physical value. `display` is canonical and round-trips exactly through [`parse_quantity`].

oneOf.description: A ratio in decibels (`ac_db_at` checks).

PinRef.description: Part pin as REFDES.PIN, e.g. "R3.1" or "U1.OUT_A".

BlockPort.description: A named interface of a block, bound to the net that carries it (checked by ERC009).

part.description:
The component as a part: id (`lib:<name>`), category `X`, title, refdes `prefix`, pins,
params (each with a unit, a default and a range), limits and symbol (`auto`, a box the
editor draws from the pins, or a registry symbol whose anchors match the pins). It has no
`spice` line: its model is.

rules.description: A composite's part values from its params (LLD §17 D5), searched over the E-series.

contract.description: What the component promises and the bench that tests it (D10): characterisation runs it.

prefix.description: Refdes prefix when it is not the category letter (`RV`, `TP`); see [`EXTRA_PREFIXES`].

units.description: Units of a multi-unit IC (e.g. `[A, B]` for a dual op-amp). Empty for single-unit parts.

params.description: Every param must declare a default, so instances always carry a full param set.

dc_param.description: For voltage sources: the param holding V(P) − V(N) at DC (used by ERC007).

symbol.description: Schematic symbol, `symbols/<id>.svg`; its pin anchors are matched by pin name.

oneOf.description:
A component from the project library (a sub-circuit): its behaviour comes from its pins'
semantics, not from a category rule, and it compiles to an `X` line.

dc_group.description:
For a library component: the pins joined by a DC path inside it share a group, and group 0
is a DC path to ground (ERC003 on the outside, LLD §17 D6). Computed by `apply()` from the
component's own netlist, never taken from a client; unused on registry parts, whose
category says which pins conduct.

oneOf.description: Not connected internally; exempt from ERC001.

min.description: In SI units. YAML sources may write a prefixed number such as `1p` or `100meg`.

SpiceDef.description:
SPICE emission template. `line` is for single-unit parts; `unit_line` is emitted once per
used unit of a multi-unit part. Placeholders: `{refdes}`, `{unit}`, pin names, param names.
In `unit_line`, a unit pin is named without its `_<unit>` suffix (`{OUT}` → `OUT_A`).

laws.description: One law per entry, as written.

oneOf.description: Laws compiled to B-sources, R, C and I ([`crate::behavioral`]).

pins.description: Component pin -> port of the `.subckt`; every port is mapped once.

oneOf.description: A vendor `.subckt`, parsed by an allow-list and re-emitted ([`crate::spice_import`]).

Model.description: What the component does inside (LLD §17 D3).

params.description:
Values as written ("10k"), or, in a component with params, expressions of them
("10k*gain"); a missing param takes the part's default, unless the rules set it.

parts.description: Local refdes (`R1`, `U1`, scoped to the definition) -> part.

nets.description:
Net -> pins. A net named after one of the component's pins is that pin; `GND` is the
circuit's ground; every other net is internal.

Composite.description: A sub-circuit of registry parts and other library components.

Provenance.description: Who made a definition (LLD §17 D10: trust levels read it).

funcs.description: User functions, `"name(a, b)" -> body`; a function may call those before it.

solve.description:
Steps in order. A part's local refdes (`R1`, or `R1.resistance` for a part with several
params) sets that part value; any other name (lowercase) is an intermediate value.

estimates.description: Forward estimates, each scored against the target or step of the same name.

prefer.description: Steps to keep near a nominal value when the estimates tie.

spec.description: Spec targets derived from the inputs and the chosen values (a follower's gain of 1).

checks.description: Checks on the bench's nets, each with a `target` expression of the component's params.

parts.description:
Registry parts around the component: sources, loads, feedback. Values may be expressions
of the component's params.

nets.description: Net -> pins; `DUT.<pin>` is the component's pin, `GND` is ground.

analyses.description: Analyses the checks do not imply (a DC sweep for `dc_transfer`).

symbol.description: A few characters for badges on the drawing: `fc`, `Q`, `Vth+`.

pass.description: Which side of a corner is the pass band (corner and Q checks).

edge.description: Output edge whose input level is the threshold (threshold checks).

at_hz.description: Frequency a gain is measured at; default 1 kHz.

tran.description:
The transient a time-domain check needs. Regenerative circuits (a Schmitt trigger) switch
late in simulation unless the steps are near the op-amp's own speed: with coarse steps the
integrator follows the unstable balance point until it hits a rail.

supply.description:
Supply ports a headroom check measures against: the positive one, then optionally the
negative one (ground without it).

at_v.description: Input level a `dc_transfer` check reads the output at, volts.

compare.description: How the measurement passes; each kind has a default (headroom: at least the target).

target.description:
A component contract's target, as an expression of the component's params (`gain`,
`1/(2*pi*r*c)`). Template checks take theirs from the block's spec instead.

CheckDef.description:
One spec check: what to measure (a closed set of kinds, so a template can never inject SPICE)
on which ports. Its target is the block's `spec[name]`.

oneOf.description: −3 dB frequency below the pass-band gain (AC).

Q of a 2nd-order low/high-pass: |H(f0)| / pass-band gain, f0 at the ∓90° phase point (AC).
Assumes the input port is driven with flat phase (a source or a buffer).
|V(out)| / |V(in)| at `at_hz` (AC).
Band-pass centre, √(f_lo·f_hi) of the −3 dB points around the peak (AC).
Band-pass Q, centre / (f_hi − f_lo) (AC).

Frequency of a periodic output: two periods between rising crossings of mid-level, in the
second half of the transient (tran).
Share of a period the output is high, from its average over two periods (tran).
Half the peak-to-peak output (tran).
Average output over the transient: the DC level (ngspice `.meas` has no OP mode).
Input level at the 2nd rising/falling output edge: a comparator threshold (tran).

How far the output stays inside its supply over the second half of the run: the smaller of
V(supply+) - max V(out) and min V(out) - V(supply-) (ground without a second supply
port). Passes at least the target by default: "avoid clipping", measured (LLD §17 D7).

Gain in dB at `at_hz` (default 1 kHz): 20·log10 |V(out)/V(in)|, or |V(out)| re 1 V
without `in` (AC).

RMS of the output around its average over the second half of the run (tran): a signal
level that ignores the bias of a single-supply stage.
Output level at the input level `at_v`, from a DC sweep of the source driving `in`.

10-90% rise time of the output's first rising edge in the second half of the run, levels
from its own minimum and maximum there (tran).

CheckKind.description:
LLD §7 spec checks. Each is a few primitive ngspice `.meas` results combined by
[`evaluate_checks`] (ngspice cannot measure an expression such as `vdb(out)-vdb(in)`).

oneOf.description: Within ±tol of the target.
At least the target, less tol.
At most the target, plus tol.

Compare.description: How a measurement passes against its target and tolerance.

set.description:
Param overrides as `REFDES.param` -> value as typed (`"V2.frequency": "1k"`), applied to a
scratch copy, so each scenario has its own netlist and cache entry.

analyses.description: The analyses this scenario runs; absent, the circuit's own.

oneOf.description: Half the peak-to-peak over the transient's second half.
Average over the transient's second half (the DC level, bias included).
|V(net)| / |V(input)| in the AC sweep at `at_hz`.

Measure.description: What a probe reads from its net in each scenario.

evidence.description: What will prove it; met, missing or unverifiable is decided from these after simulation.

oneOf.description: A block's spec check (`b2.fc_hz`).
A probe of a test plan in one scenario, against a target.

A fact about the circuit itself ("every op-amp is an LM358"), checked by the core's
structure queries when they exist; until then it is unverifiable, never met.

op_index.description: Index of the failing op within a batch (`apply_all`).

oneOf.description: Envelope or body does not match the schema.
Envelope `v` is not the current or previous protocol version.
Circuit and registry versions differ.
Refdes is malformed or its prefix does not match the part category.
A value string could not be parsed in the param's unit.
Swap target is in a different category.
Malformed net id, ground misuse, or a kind/label that disagrees with the existing net.
Net id already exists (case-insensitive, since SPICE node names are).
Block still has parts or hints referring to it.
Analysis parameters are invalid.
The author is not allowed to emit this op (e.g. `part.pin` is user-only).
No block template with this id in the registry.
A template target or rail voltage is malformed or outside the template's range.
A port binding names a net that cannot carry that port (wrong kind, missing, ground misuse).
The compiler refused a circuit that `apply()` accepted (a generated block's bench).
A library component definition is malformed (every problem listed in the message).
No library component with this id in the circuit.
The library component is still used by a part or by another component.
A test plan or a requirement is malformed, or names something the circuit lacks.

ErrorCode.description:
Error codes returned by `apply()`. These go back to the LLM verbatim during repair and are
shown to users as friendly text (LLD §4). Additive only within a protocol major version.

oneOf.description: Inverse of `block.begin`.
Inverse of `block.commit` / `block.abort`.
Inverse of `hint.add`.
Add a component definition to the project library (LLD §17 D13).
Replace a definition; its instances and the definitions that use it are checked again.
Remove a definition nothing uses. Inverse of `lib.add`.
Replace an instance of a library component by its parts, as a block.
Replace a block's spec targets (a deliberate retune).

params.description: Values as written ("10k", "4.7u"); unspecified params take the registry default.

origin.description: Normally derived from the envelope; set explicitly by inverse ops so undo restores it.

kind.description: Applied when the net is created; must match if the net exists.

def.description: Boxed: a definition is large next to every other op body.

block.description: Id of the block the parts form; default the lowest free `bN`.
